subject: reasoning
question: Eight people, D, E, M, P, T, W, Y and Z are sitting in a straight line, facing north. M sits at one of the extreme ends of the line. Only two people sit between M and E. D sits third to the right of E. Only four people sit between D and T. Z sits to the immediate right of P. W does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the line. How many people sit to the right of Y?
solution:
Given: Eight people, D, E, M, P, T, W, Y and Z are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) M sits at one of the extreme ends of the line.

2) Only two people sit between M and E.

3) D sits third to the right of E.
